title: Training & Inference Tools
summary: This module provides essential tools for both training and deploying models, encompassing advanced text generation capabilities, integrations with external MLOps platforms, and command-line utilities for model serving.

nodes.label: Text Generation Utilities
nodes.title: Model Generation Core
nodes.description: Provides comprehensive functionalities for text generation, including various decoding strategies, continuous batching, and state management for efficient inference.

nodes.label: External System Integrations
nodes.title: External Tool Connectors
nodes.description: Offers utilities for connecting with external tools like Weights & Biases for hyperparameter search, DVCLive for experiment tracking, and PEFT for efficient fine-tuning.

nodes.label: CLI Model Serving Tools
nodes.title: Command-Line Interface for Serving
nodes.description: Enables serving Hugging Face models via an HTTP API, supporting features like continuous batching, quantization, and various generation tasks through a command-line interface.

nodes.label: Model Trainer Class
nodes.title: Core Training & Evaluation Loop
nodes.description: The central utility for orchestrating model training, evaluation, and prediction loops, interacting with callbacks, optimizers, and schedulers.

groups.label: Training & Experimentation Support
groups.title: Training & Experimentation Support
groups.description: Components that facilitate model training, evaluation, and integration with MLOps platforms for experiment tracking and hyperparameter optimization.

groups.label: Inference & Deployment
groups.title: Inference & Deployment
groups.description: Tools designed for efficient model inference, including advanced text generation capabilities and command-line interfaces for deploying models as services.
